links.title: Follow the beginner course
links.description: A chaptered introduction covering media, editing, Fusion, color, audio and delivery. Use the chapter list to choose a starting point, and check interface differences against your Resolve version.

links.title: Start the Fusion chapter
links.description: Jump to the course's introduction to the Fusion page at 1:43:14. Follow this section when you want to move from timeline editing into compositing.

links.title: Start the color chapter
links.description: Jump to the Color page chapter at 2:50:20. Choose this section if you already know basic editing and want to explore grading.

links.title: Start learning Fusion
links.description: A beginner course covering node-based compositing, masks, animation and 3D. The provider offers free access through its account and checkout flow.

links.title: Browse practical tutorials
links.description: Explore worked examples for Fusion compositing and Resolve workflows.

links.title: Explore Fusion expressions
links.description: Examples for simple expressions, masks and timing, with explanations for learning how they work.

links.title: Find Fusion scripting references
links.description: Entry points to the Fusion and composition API references. Check the documentation and your Resolve setup before running a script.

links.title: Follow the official training programme
links.description: Choose training videos, books and lesson files for editing, grading, audio and compositing. Match the material to the Resolve version you use.
